Deschloroketamine Dinner Menus
Deschloroketamine is new to me and was sold to me as Ketamine, but I'm glad they did because it's a much better drug for me. I am an avid tester of any and all chemical I or anyone around me put into their body so I regularly use bunk police test kits which is how I found out what it really was.
First thing to note is that it's smooth on my nasal cavities (much smoother than ketamine) and so I don't end up with a clogged nasal passage after 1-2 doses. It's stronger I think by at least double that of ketamine. And yes, the ketamine I've done came straight from a vet and plain old air dried by me so I'm definitely not making comparisons of the usual trash people buy on the streets these days.
Secondly, it's amazing fun for my innate creative impulses. I don't mean to say it makes me want to go make art, I mean it seemed to trigger a visual version of parts of the world around me that were fascinatingly creative. Prime example was a dinner menu at a rather nice restaurant. This was my first public experience with this drug. I was trying to decide what to have for dinner while ping ponging conversations and other social things; par for the course when at dinner with friends. I had had one margarita about an hour before this, but I'm a 3 margarita to feel tipsy person so I doubt this had impact on my experience.
So as distractions at the dinner table took me to and from this dinner menu (which had less than 5 items under each course so a one pager) kept changing... Always in a good way though! I must have read the entire one page menu 10 times and every time the dish was different but always elaborate and delicious sounding. I didn't write this down though I wish I had he wherewithal to think to, but for example (I'm making this up sober) the steak item would at one point be something like a grass-fed flat iron with bacon-wrapped scallops on havarti Mac-n-Cheese, and arugula salad. Then I'd read it again and and it may have changed to something like 'NY Strip with pineapple reduction glaze and a side of butternut squash with toasted pecan stuffed peppers.... I'm making this up, some of this stuff I've never even heard of, but I hope makes the point, every time it was an elaborate description of things I'd never thought to try together and continuously torn as to what to order! Hahaha.
Moral of the story? If you're gonna go to a nice place for dinner on this drug, you may want to take a little recorder or notebook and see what recipes your subconscious creative alter ego comes up with....
Other things to note are that the drug is quite enjoyable. I don't get too relaxed or tired, my ego-aside clarity of thought for problem solving is as acute as with ketamine, and it's cheaper.
[Reported Dose: '2.5-5 mg per dose']
